hero.title: Census 2027
hero.description: Your friendly, multilingual guide to the upcoming Indian Census. Learn what to expect, how to participate, and how to stay safe.

features.understandDesc: Learn about the two phases of the census and what information is collected.
features.stateDesc: Find out exactly when the Census is happening in your state or Union Territory.
features.worksDesc: A step-by-step guide explaining the survey process and how to participate safely.
features.chatDesc: Have questions? Chat with our AI assistant in your preferred language.

phases.title: The Two Phases of Census 2027
phases.subtitle: The census is conducted in two separate visits to your home.
phases.phase1Desc: Government workers will visit to collect basic information about your house and amenities.
phases.phase2Desc: A few months later, workers will return to count the members of your household.
